mandatoryCriteria: PostgreSQL baseline: Schema migrations apply cleanly and establish relational integrity
Restricted foreign keys: fk_workspaces_owner prevents deleting active workspace owners
Advisory locks: Concurrent migration runners serialize cleanly without race conditions or schema corruption
Failure rollback: Failed migrations roll back completely without leaving partial artifacts
scopeAndExclusions: In-scope: PostgreSQL schema, migration runner, transaction rollback, and constraints. Out-of-scope: Distributed cross-region replication.
